establishments.name: WA Virtual Hospital
establishments.locationNote: WA Virtual Hospital: a virtual service (WA Virtual Emergency Department, WAVED) with no physical emergency department. Not in SLIP. Shown at a placeholder point in the Perth CBD.

triageSources.targetMin: ED Business Rules July 2026 §7.4 Table 1 (ATS1 ≤2 min, ATS2 ≤10, ATS3 ≤30, ATS4 ≤60, ATS5 ≤120; adapted from ACEM). The Data Dictionary 2026 p.98 labels ATS1 'immediate (within seconds)'.
triageSources.kpiPct: EXTERNAL: 'seen within recommended times' thresholds as published in WA HSP annual reports (for example EMHS); the indicator is defined in the WA Health 2025-26 OBM KPI Data Definition Manual §7.1.0. Not in the EDDC documents. Shown as reference ticks only; to be confirmed by the custodian.

accessTargets._source: EXTERNAL, not in the EDDC documents (Business Rules §12 refers to the WA Emergency Access Measures and MP 0111/19 without figures). WEAT: 4-Hour Rule / WA Emergency Access Target. EAR: Emergency Access Reform measures as reported by the Office of the Auditor General WA. To be confirmed by the custodian.
